title: Learning Generative Ranking Policies for Whole-Page Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.25527v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A recommendation page is consumed as a whole: the items on it compete for attention and complement one another, so the best page is not simply the individually best items placed side by side. We study whole-page optimization, which selects and orders the items on a page jointly to maximize the score of the page. The number of possible pages grows combinatorially, so good pages must be generated rather than enumerated. Some generative re-ranking methods use the same page-level training signal for every choice in a sampled page. Others imitate target pages built before training, which remain largely fixed as the generator improves. We address both limitations with one local page-level objective, which repeatedly moves the current generator toward pages with higher score. translated_title: 面向整页优化的生成式排序策略学习
translated_abstract: 推荐页面是作为一个整体被消费的：页面上的物品既相互争夺注意力又彼此互补，因此最优页面并非简单地由各自最优的物品并排放置而成。我们研究整页优化问题，即联合地选择和排列页面上的物品以最大化页面整体的得分。可能的页面数量呈组合式增长，因此好的页面必须通过生成而非枚举的方式获得。一些生成式重排方法对采样页面中的每个选择都使用相同的页面级训练信号；另一些方法则模仿在训练前构建的目标页面，而这些目标页面在生成器不断改进的过程中基本保持固定不变。我们用一个局部页面级目标同时解决了上述两个局限，该目标反复地将当前生成器向得分更高的页面推进。这一目标可以精确地拆分为每个位置一个训练目标，每个目标通过完整页面的得分来比较同一部分页面下的候选物品……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出一种局部页面级训练目标，可精确拆分为逐位置的训练信号，使生成式排序策略在整页优化中动态生成更高分的页面，同时克服了现有方法中统一页面级信号和固定模仿目标的双重局限。
en_tdlr: We propose a local page-level objective that exactly splits into per-position training targets, enabling generative ranking policies to dynamically generate higher-scoring pages for whole-page optimization, overcoming both the uniform page-level signal and fixed imitation target limitations of prior methods.
